shortDescription: Israel's largest telecoms group Bezeq Israel Telecom TASE:BEZQ reported on Wednesday higher quarterly profit, boosted by stronger revenue in its core fixed-line business as well as in mobile phone and TV units.

children: Israel's largest telecoms group Bezeq Israel Telecom
reported on Wednesday higher quarterly profit, boosted by stronger revenue in its core fixed-line business as well as in mobile phone and TV units.
Third-quarter adjusted net profit grew 44% to 372 million shekels ($117.3 million), while revenue rose 1.2% to 2.17 billion shekels
Bezeq maintained its 2026 estimates of 1.15 billion to 1.2 billion in net profit and 3.8 billion to 3.85 billion shekels in adjusted earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation
Its fibre optics network deployment reached 3.1 million homes, of which 36% were customers. Average revenue in fixed line, mainly in broadband, edged up to 142 shekels a month
Third-quarter profit at mobile phone unit Pelephone rose 19% to 44 million shekels on a 1.5% rise in revenue to 525 million. The number of subscribers grew to 2.601 million from 2.583 million
Bezeq agreed to buy smaller mobile rival Wecom Mobile for up to 265 million shekels, but the deal still needs regulatory approvals
TV unit Yes posted a 36 million shekel gain in third-quarter net profit after a 1 million shekel loss a year earlier. Revenue rose 15% to 370 million shekels

title: Israel's Bezeq Telecom profit jumps as fibre network deployment continues
